verdict.rationale: Folk's own REST API returns JSON, an open format. Documented read paths cover groups, people, companies, custom fields, custom objects and deals, so an AI-native user can pull workspace data out programmatically. However, no first-party bulk export or 'download all data' feature is evidenced, and API access appears limited to a higher pricing tier. Full extraction would mean scripting paginated calls under rate limits. Missing for 10: a documented one-click or bulk export of all data (e.g. CSV/JSON archive), explicit coverage of notes, interactions and email history in any export, export available on all plans, and independent or hands-on confirmation of a complete data exit.
